components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Compact primary action using the logo-derived ocean primary token.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 2rem; gap: 0.375rem; padding: 0 0.625rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius-lg, 0.45rem); background: var(--color-primary); color: var(--color-primary-foreground); font: 500 0.875rem/1.25 var(--font-sans); white-space: nowrap; transition: background-color 180ms ease-out, transform 180ms ease-out, box-shadow 180ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-primary) 80%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Muted action for filtering, cancelling, and secondary workflows.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 2rem; padding: 0 0.625rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius-lg, 0.45rem); background: var(--secondary); color: var(--secondary-foreground); font: 500 0.875rem/1.25 var(--font-sans); transition: background-color 180ms ease-out, box-shadow 180ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--secondary) 80%, transparent); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Input
components.description: Compact dark-mode text field with visible focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 2rem; min-width: 0; border: 1px solid var(--input); border-radius: var(--radius-lg, 0.45rem); background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--input) 30%, transparent); color: var(--foreground); padding: 0.25rem 0.625rem; font: 400 0.875rem/1.5 var(--font-sans); transition: border-color 180ms ease-out, box-shadow 180ms ease-out; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); } .ds-input:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Flat tonal panel with ring structure instead of decorative elevation.
components.html:
Request Logs

Inspect request execution, latency, and sanitized payloads.
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1rem; overflow: hidden; border-radius: calc(var(--radius, 0.45rem) * 1.4); background: var(--card); color: var(--card-foreground); padding: 1rem; font: 400 0.875rem/1.5 var(--font-sans); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 10%, transparent); } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0; font: 500 1rem/1.375 var(--font-sans); } .ds-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--muted-foreground); }

components.name: Badge
components.description: Compact pill for state and metadata, not decoration.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 1.25rem; width: fit-content; gap: 0.25rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 9999px; background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-success, var(--primary)) 24%, transparent); color: var(--color-success, var(--primary)); padding: 0.125rem 0.5rem; font: 500 0.75rem/1 var(--font-sans); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-badge:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.description: Compact sidebar row with icon, label, and clear active state.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; height: 2rem; border-radius: var(--radius-lg, 0.45rem); padding: 0 0.5rem; color: var(--sidebar-foreground); font: 400 0.875rem/1.25 var(--font-sans); text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 180ms ease-out, color 180ms ease-out; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: var(--sidebar-accent); color: var(--sidebar-accent-foreground); } .ds-nav-item-active { background: var(--sidebar-accent); color: var(--sidebar-accent-foreground); font-weight: 500; } .ds-nav-icon { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 1.125rem; height: 1.125rem; font-size: 0.625rem; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--sidebar-ring) 50%, transparent); }

narrative.overview: Oceans Gateway Admin is a focused, technical operations console that should feel native to the gateway runtime. Its visual language is dark, restrained, and state-forward: charcoal surfaces, crisp borders, compact controls, and a single ocean-blue accent role used to identify primary action and active state. Green is reserved for semantic success, not brand identity.
keyCharacteristics: Dark operations console with same-origin product feel.
Compact, familiar controls for experienced admins.
Precise labels, visible state, and quiet hierarchy.
Logo-derived ocean blues are the primary color direction.

rules.name: The Accent Scarcity Rule
rules.body: The primary accent identifies action, active state, or meaningful status. It is not decoration and should stay below roughly 10% of a screen.

rules.name: The Logo Blue Rule
rules.body: Primary action, active navigation, focus color, and brand charts use the logo-blue family. Green is semantic success only.

rules.name: The One-Family Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce display fonts or decorative pairings in the admin UI. Product trust comes from consistency, not typographic novelty.

rules.name: The Identifier Rule
rules.body: Use monospace only when the string is machine-like: request IDs, keys, JSON, config snippets, or code. Do not make the whole console terminal-themed.

rules.name: The Border-First Rule
rules.body: If a surface can be understood with a tonal layer and 1px border, do not add a shadow.

rules.name: The No Ghost-Card Rule
rules.body: Do not pair decorative 1px borders with wide soft shadows on routine cards or buttons. Choose structure or elevation, not both.

dos: Do use the existing token system in src/styles/globals.css before adding new values.
Do keep routine admin surfaces compact, legible, and state-rich.
Do use tonal layers and borders to organize dense data before reaching for shadows.
Do reserve primary color for primary actions, active navigation, selected state, and meaningful status.
Do keep logo-derived ocean blue as the primary action, focus, active-state, and chart-ramp family.
Do keep focus states visible and test dense forms with keyboard navigation.
donts: Don't make decorative SaaS dashboards: no glossy cards, vanity metrics, busy gradients, or ornamental chart chrome.
Don't simplify away operational detail around permissions, budgets, request behavior, lifecycle state, or destructive actions.
Don't use gradient text, side-stripe card accents, decorative grid backgrounds, or glassmorphism as default styling.
Don't introduce display fonts, oversized radii, or theatrical page-load motion into the product UI.
Don't use green as brand color; reserve it for semantic success only.
